title: server.availability (server → platform, reliable)
description: Availability changed. `reason` when busy: `local_match` (a match loaded on the server itself, detail = its slug), `awaiting_reset` (the assigned series is over and waits for the reset, detail = match id), `assigned` (an assigned match runs, detail = match id), `match_disabled` (no match plugin), `draining` (detail = the drain reason). When available: `idle`, `series_end` or `reset`. Older Ready Up sends other free text.

detail.description: What the reason refers to (match id, local slug, drain reason); null when nothing.
